requirements.title: NuclearLang
requirements.why: the compiler, the dragonfly command and the code of the AI services

requirements.title: uv
requirements.why: makes the Python environments of the services and brings its own Python; it goes in your user folder

requirements.title: Ollama
requirements.why: runs the local models and keeps them: it loads one when an agent asks and frees its memory afterwards

install.darwin: brew install ollama && brew services start ollama

note.linux: Ollama's own installer: it asks for your password, because it installs Ollama as a service of the system.
note.darwin: With Homebrew; without it, download the app from Ollama's page and open it once.

profiles.title: Remote agents only
profiles.summary: Nothing runs on this machine. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode get the Nuclear MCP server: the generators, the compiler and the command line.
works: the generators (a resource, a use case, a screen) from your agent
the compiler's checks and fixes, the documentation of every kind and decorator
dragonfly build, test and migrate from your agent
limits: your agent writes every line the generators do not: all of it is paid tokens
no Smart Graph: no strategy for a request, no search of the knowledge base
no Loop panel and no Nuclear agent chat in the editor

profiles.title: Lite
profiles.summary: One 1.5B model does everything: for a machine with little memory.
works: the Smart Graph: the strategy of each request and the knowledge base, for the local agents and for your remote agent
the generators and the compiler's fixes, which need no model
limits: not measured yet: its model is half the size of the coder the project measures, so expect it to miss more and your remote agent to correct more
plans, reviews and chat answers come from a small model made for code

profiles.title: Medium
profiles.summary: The coder the project measures does everything, also the plans and the reviews: one 3B model in memory.
works: the Smart Graph: the strategy of each request and the knowledge base, for the local agents and for your remote agent
the generators and the compiler's fixes, which need no model
a file is written as in hard: 43 of 45 single-file tasks (Claude Sonnet: 39), 16 of 18 never seen before
limits: plans, reviews and chat answers come from a model made for code: 6 of the first 8 chat questions as required, where hard answers 10 of 10
some answers are slow: one chat question had not ended after five minutes
turning a request in plain words into generator calls is not measured yet with this model
profiles.measured: as coder, the model of hard: 43 of 45 single-file tasks, 16 of 18 never seen; as assistant, 6 of the first 8 chat questions (hard: 10 of 10)

profiles.title: Hard
profiles.summary: The set every measurement of the project was made with: a coder and a separate model to plan, review and answer.
works: the Smart Graph: the strategy of each request and the knowledge base, for the local agents and for your remote agent
the generators and the compiler's fixes, which need no model
43 of 45 single-file tasks (Claude Sonnet: 39), 16 of 18 never seen before
the assistant answers 10 of 10 questions about NuclearLang as required, and reads 10 of 11 requests right
limits: its assistant model takes 7.2 GB: with 16 GB of memory little else stays open
a whole feature of several files passes 2 times of 3: your remote agent validates and corrects
profiles.measured: 43 of 45 single-file tasks (Claude Sonnet: 39), 16 of 18 never seen, 2 of 3 whole features, 10 of 10 chat questions, 10 of 11 analyses
